Replace.Text: A district unique to Zulu which replaces the Encampment. Provides +2 Loyalty per turn in this city. Provides +1 [ICON_Housing] Housing. Once the Civic or Technology prerequisite is met, Corps and Armies can be built outright. Buildings in the Ikanda receive +2 [ICON_GOLD] Gold and +1 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science. Faster Corps and Army creation.

A district unique to Vietnam which replaces the Encampment. Provides +2 Loyalty per turn in this city. +2 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture for each adjacent district. After Flight is researched receive [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism equal to the [ICON_CULTURE] Culture output. This district does not require population, is cheaper to build, cannot be built adjacent to the city center, does not provide [ICON_GreatPerson] Great People points, and is not a specialty district.

A building unique to Macedon.+25% combat experience for all melee, ranged land units, and Hetairoi trained in this city. Gain [ICON_SCIENCE] Science equal to 25% of the unit's cost when a non civilian unit is created in this city. Provides +2 Loyalty per turn in this city.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Strategic Resource Stockpiles increased +10 (on Standard Speed).[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]May not be built in an Encampment district that already has a Stable.

A building unique to Mongolia. Grants an ability that gives +1 [ICON_MOVEMENT] Movement to Heavy and Light Cavalry trained in this city. +25% combat experience for all cavalry and siege class units trained in this city. Provides +2 Loyalty per turn in this city.[NEWLINE]Strategic Resource Stockpiles increased +10 (on Standard Speed).[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]May not be built in an Encampment district that already has a Barracks.
+5 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength and +1 Movement for units in friendly territory.
+5 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength and +1 Movement for units in friendly territory.
Babylonian unique Ancient era anti-cavalry unit. Requires less production and has no maintenance costs or technology requirements. This unit has 3 [ICON_Movement] Movement and sight.

A district unique to Russia for religious activity. Replaces the Holy Site district and cheaper to build.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Your city border grows by one tile each time a Great Person is expended in this city.
Holy Sites provide +2 [ICON_FOOD] Food and +2 [ICON_HOUSING] Housing if placed on a river. Holy Sites trigger a Culture Bomb.

+6 [ICON_FAITH] Faith. A building unique to Khmer. Replaces the Temple. Required to purchase Apostles and Inquisitors with [ICON_Faith] Faith. +0.5 [ICON_Culture] Culture for every [ICON_CITIZEN] population in this city.
Holy Sites provide [ICON_CULTURE] Culture equal to their adjacency bonus. Farms provide a little [ICON_FAITH] Faith adjacency to Hippodromes and Holy Sites.
Can train Comandante Generals in your [ICON_Capital] Capital.
Promoting a unit does not end that unit’s turn.
[ICON_TechBoosted] Eurekas provide all of the [ICON_SCIENCE] Science for technologies. -40% [ICON_SCIENCE] Science per population.
